single_purpose: Provide AI-generated answer suggestions for a quiz question visible in the user's active tab. The user chooses an image-capable model through their own Gemini, OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible API account and explicitly triggers each solve. The extension displays the result on the page; it does not click or submit an answer.
activeTab: Used to access the active tab after the user invokes a keyboard shortcut or popup solve button and capture its visible area with chrome.tabs.captureVisibleTab. The screenshot is sent directly to the user's selected AI provider for the requested quiz analysis. This permission is not used to record browsing history or continuously capture tabs.
scripting: Used to inject the packaged content.js and styles.css into the active page when its content script is not already available, so the extension can show processing, answer and error feedback. The injected code is bundled in the extension. API responses are parsed as data, not executed as JavaScript or WebAssembly.
storage: Used for chrome.storage.local to retain the user's Gemini/OpenAI API keys, custom API base URL, explicitly selected models and answer display preference. The extension does not use chrome.storage.sync. Screenshots, answer history and optional audio/video context are not saved to extension storage.
host_permissions: The required Gemini and OpenAI hosts allow authenticated model-list and image-analysis requests. Packaged content scripts match ordinary webpages to display answer feedback on the user's active quiz page; they do not scrape page content or make screenshot requests on their own. Optional HTTP/HTTPS host patterns support user-entered OpenAI-compatible API URLs. The extension requests access to the specific custom-server origin when the user saves that URL, rather than granting every optional origin automatically. The server must support /models and image input at /chat/completions.
